reason: I never pay for apps. For my concours file I can make the CV free here or with Canva and ChatGPT, and I'd use the free AI action, but that's where I'd stop.
objection: A bit.ly link going around on WhatsApp, from people I don't know, asking for my MoMo. It looks like the scams I see every week, and a concours doesn't even pick you by how well your CV fits an offer.
would_change_my_mind: A friend I trust who got a job or passed a concours with it, and paid without any trouble.
